evidence_level: public measured isolated median latency + explicit synthetic deterministic power/thermal model

assumptions.other_single_cores: core1/core2 isolated duration equals measured core0; unmeasured symmetry
assumptions.concurrency: two independent contexts on disjoint core masks can progress simultaneously; unverified on device
assumptions.slowdown: during overlap both make isolated-work progress at 1/(1+sigma); outside overlap at 1; active power remains unchanged
assumptions.cpu: A and B use separate fixed CPU resources; pre starts at zero and ends together; post starts immediately after own NPU completion
assumptions.frequency: one fixed shared NPU control state; actual source benchmark frequency not established as locked
assumptions.power: common baseline once; nonnegative additive active increments; no temperature-dependent leakage, DVFS, sleep or switching energy
assumptions.thermal: one aggregate NPU RC node; CPU/GPU and remaining baseline outside this thermal boundary but inside system energy
assumptions.gpu: no GPU task or mapping decision in this admission instance; baseline included in common system term
assumptions.service: two fixed FP requests, exactly one complete pre/main/post each; no batching, precision change, drops or early exits
assumptions.latency_interpretation: reported median hardware timing used as deterministic model input; not hardware WCET or full request latency
